name: Uply — Scroll to Top, Progress Bar & Read Time
author: shoiswp

sections.description:
Ultimate UX Toolkit: Advanced Scroll to Top, Progress Bar, and Smart Reading Time.

Uply is designed to solve one major problem: Reader Fatigue. Long articles can be overwhelming, but with the right visual cues, you can keep users engaged and navigating effortlessly. This plugin brings together three essential tools – Scroll to Top, Progress Bar, and Reading Time — all optimized for speed and SEO.

1. Advanced Scroll to Top Button

Make site navigation effortless. Say goodbye to boring navigation and give your users a stylish way to return to the top.

  • Standard Icon Library: Access a clean collection of Arrows, Chevrons, and Circles that fits any theme.
  • Flexible Positioning: Toggle between Left or Right alignment with adjustable bottom margins.
  • Custom SVG Icon Builder: Upload your own branding icons and fully customize background colors, borders, and hover effects.
  • Mobile Visibility Control: Keep your mobile interface clean by specifically enabling or disabling the button on mobile devices.
  • 58+ Premium Button Designs [PRO]: Upgrade to a massive library featuring Rocket icons, Paper planes, 3D animated buttons, and unique modern shapes.
  • 10+ Special Progress Buttons [PRO]: A high-end feature where a circular or square progress indicator is built directly around the button, filling up as the user scrolls.
  • Unique Styles & Fluid Animations [PRO]: Every Pro button comes with “Joss” (stunning) animations and designer-grade transitions that make your site stand out.

2. Dynamic Reading Progress Bar

A visual roadmap that encourages users to finish your articles. Give your readers a sense of accomplishment as they scroll.

  • Sleek Minimalist Styles: Solid, Segmented, or Rainbow bars that track progress in real-time.
  • Top Positioning: A standard, non-intrusive bar fixed to the top of the viewport.
  • Bottom Viewport Toggle: Choose to fix the progress bar to either the top or the bottom of the screen.
  • Precision Height & Thickness: Use a range slider to adjust the thickness of the bar to match your brand’s style perfectly.
  • Intelligent Sticky Offset: Smart “Space Above/Below” settings to prevent the bar from overlapping with your sticky headers or menus.
  • 30+ Premium Animation Styles [PRO]: Access 30+ stunning animations, including Neon Glow, Liquid Metal, Gradient Waves, and Glitch effects.
  • Advanced Unique Designs [PRO]: High-end, eye-catching designs that elevate your website’s aesthetic instantly.

3. Smart Reading Time Indicator

Transparency builds trust. Letting readers know the time commitment upfront significantly reduces bounce rates.

  • Precision WPM Algorithm: Automatically calculates reading time based on a customizable “Words Per Minute” logic.
  • Clean Text Layout: Displays a simple, automated “X min read” label before your content.
  • Dual-Positioning Display: Display the reading time Before Content, After Content, or in Both locations simultaneously.
  • Full Typography & Styling Suite: Total control over font size, colors, background padding, and margins—no coding required.
  • Custom Labels: Fully customize your Prefix (e.g., “Ready in:”) and Postfix (e.g., “minutes”) text.
  • 25+ Designer Layouts [PRO]: Access 25+ unique and advanced layouts featuring professional icons like Clocks, Books, Hourglasses, and Sand-timers.
  • Stunning Layout Animations [PRO]: Beautifully animated entry and hover effects for the reading time badge.

4. Intelligent Targeting & Performance

Uply is built for speed and control. It gives power users the tools they need without sacrificing performance.

  • Vanilla CSS Power: No heavy libraries (No jQuery UI or GSAP). All animations are built with optimized CSS for zero impact on Core Web Vitals.
  • Conditional Display Logic: Enable or disable features globally or for specific Post Types (e.g., show on Posts but hide on Pages).
  • Precise Page Exclusion: Use a built-in search interface to exclude specific Page IDs or posts where you don’t want the tools to appear.

Why Choose Uply?

Whether you use the feature-packed Free version or the designer-grade PRO version, Uply is engineered to improve your “Time on Site” and “Bounce Rate” — two of the most important metrics for SEO and user satisfaction.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/uply-scroll-to-top directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Uply menu in the dashboard to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Can I hide the Scroll to Top button on mobile?

Yes, there is a setting to toggle visibility on mobile devices.

How is the read time calculated?

It is based on the word count of the post content divided by the reading speed (default 200 words per minute), which you can customize.

  • Introduced New Branded Custom SVG logos for better visual identity.
  • Enhanced UI/UX with modern Toast notifications replacing browser popups.
  • Improved sidebar visibility and active state icons for better navigation.
  • Optimized CSS performance and fixed minor layout bugs in the admin dashboard.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with premium dashboard UI.
  • Refactored codebase for strict WordPress compliance.
  • Enhanced security with robust nonce and permission checks.
